text_blocks.snippet: Flareon ex is a popular Fire-type Pokémon card available in multiple notable versions across the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG), most famously the Flareon EX from the Generations Radiant Collection and newer iterations like the Prismatic Evolutions Flareon ex.

snippet_links.text: Flareon EX from the Generations Radiant Collection

list.snippet: Ability: Flash Fire — Once during your turn, you can move a Fire Energy from one of your Pokémon to this Flareon EX.
Attack: Blaze Ball (3 Energy) — Does 50 base damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.
Weakness / Retreat: Water (× 2) weakness, no resistance, and a retreat cost of 2 energy.
Burning Charge (130 damage) — Lets you search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to one of your Pokémon.
Carnelian (280 damage) — Prevents Flareon ex from attacking during your next turn.

text_blocks.snippet: Opinions on Reddit are mixed regarding the card's competitive consistency. While some players note it can dominate matches with an explosive early setup (often paired with energy accelerators like Turtonator and Kiawe), others point out that it can struggle against difficult matchups like Sylveon ex or Giratina ex if you don't secure an optimal opening hand.
